brief: Slovakia's fintech/neobank/crypto/PSD2 disclosure landscape has a strong regulator spine and a thin, dispersed private-sector newsroom layer. NBS supplies the authoritative actor map through the PSD2 register, the Subjekty finančného trhu database (now with bulk download and a JSON API) and the MiCA/CASP supervision pages, while registeruz.sk plus FinStat give annual accounts and corporate events for private fintechs that never publish results. Weak funding and product signals live mainly in SK-language trade and startup media (FinReport.sk, Forbes.sk, Startitup.sk), the Slovak FinTech Association and its Fintech Hub, and the SAPIE/Dealroom Innovate Slovakia ecosystem database, complemented by regional EN trackers. The clearest gaps are BNPL, which appears to be served by Czech and passported EU providers with no confirmed SK-domiciled actor, and per-company newsroom enumeration for the six MiCA-licensed CASPs and registered AISP/PISP entities.
